sentences.text:
Order 
This Bail Application is filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita.

2. Petitioner is the accused in S.C.No.2339 of 2024 of of Additional District Court & Sessions Court (Atrocities & Sexual Violence Against Women and Children), Thiruvananthapuram registered alleging offences punishable under Section 4(2) r/w 3(a), 6 r/w 5(I) (n), 8 r/W 7 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and Section 376(2)(f)(n), 376(3), 354(B) of IPC.
3.

entities.text: Additional District Court & Sessions Court (Atrocities & Sexual Violence Against Women and Children), Thiruvananthapuram
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The prosecution case is that the victim is a minor girl aged 16 years was sexually abused by the 2024:KER:93514 BAIL APPL. NO. 9822 OF 2024 petitioner.
The petitioner is a close relative of the victim.
The allegation against the petitioner is that, while the victim was at her grandmother's house in May, 2022, she went to the bathroom, where the petitioner followed her.
It is alleged that, he with sexual intent, inappropriately touched and kissed her private parts.

Thereafter, one day when she went to the room to give tea, the petitioner closed the room from inside and caught hold her and forcibly removed her dress and made her to lie on the cot and he engaged sexual intercourse with her.
Thereafter on several occasion, the petitioner indulged sexual intercourse with her.
4. Heard counsel for the petitioner and the Public Prosecutor.
5. The counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody from 07.09.2024.

The counsel for the petitioner submitted that there is a long delay in 2024:KER:93514 BAIL APPL. NO.
9822 OF 2024 filing the complaint and that itself shows that it is a false case foisted against the petitioner.

The counsel for the petitioner also submits that the petitioner is ready to abide any Jishnu J vs State Of Kerala on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103796384/
2 conditions, if this Court grant him bail.
6.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The public prosecutor opposed the bail application.
This Court issued notice to the victim because the offence under Section 376(3) IPC is also alleged but there is no appearance.
7. This Court considered the contention of the petitioner and also the Public Prosecutor.
This Court also perused the First Information Report.
The petitioner is aged 25 years.
He is in custody from 07.09.2024.
Therefore, the trial court will take necessary steps to record the evidence of the victim immediately.

After recording the evidence of the victim, the petitioner can file appropriate application before the trial court for bail and the court concerned will consider the same in 2024:KER:93514 BAIL APPL. NO. 9822 OF 2024 accordance with law.
Accordingly the bail application is disposed of.

Sd/-
